title: Fear for Cromer Library; Wigan; Senior Librarians are to blame?
author: Ian Anstice / The Library Campaign

editorial.text: 249 libraries plus 17 mobiles currently under threat or recently closed Fears for North Norfolk libraries and Sheffield are pre-emptive in nature but realistic.
